source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, if your **WARLORD** is deployed on the battlefield, you have to make a pledge to Slaanesh: a number of enemy units you predict will be **destroyed** in that battle round. As the battle round ends, if the enemy units destroyed in it at least equal your pledge, you get as many Pact points as you pledged. If not, your **WARLORD** model takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), and you get no Pact points that battle round.

Your **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN** units get a bonus by your total of Pact points gained so far in the battle; the bonuses add up:

- 1 or more: whenever a model in the unit attacks, it can re-roll 1s to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).
- 3 or more: whenever a model in the unit attacks, it can re-roll 1s to [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls).
- 5 or more: melee weapons of the unit's models get **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** and **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- 7 or more: attacks by the unit's models score **Critical Hits** on unmodified [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 5+.
